2. A straight long wire is passed through a large piece of paper perpendicularly and connecting a $1.5\text{ V}$ pencil battery with it, current is flown through the wire and some iron dust is spread on the paper.

(a) What is the magnetic effect of current?
(b) How will the iron dust get arranged on the paper?
(c) What changes are to be made to the structure of the wire to increase the intensity of the induced magnetic field? Elaborate.
(d) Analyse the phenomenon that will happen if the wire is wrapped around an iron nail and if one end of the iron nail is taken near to the iron dust?
